blocks.text: The header documents the cloud-only editor, layout persistence, save conflict policy, proposal review, and removed local/terminal modes. Imports establish the provider, stores, panels, editor, review, search, preview, and persistence dependencies.
blocks.title: Workbench scope and dependencies

blocks.text: EditorPane keeps one CodeEditor mounted for each open path, forwards path-aware callbacks, requests measurement when visible, and registers its ref for jump-to-position actions.
blocks.title: Per-file editor pane

blocks.text: WorkbenchBody reads editor and code-context stores, creates a memoized cloud provider, initializes file/list/save/conflict/proposal/layout state, and sets up explorer, preview, and bottom-panel splitters.
blocks.title: Workbench state and providers

blocks.text: This section refreshes files and findings without clobbering dirty buffers, subscribes to provider updates and proposals, opens and closes tabs safely, rekeys per-path state after explorer renames, and adds file/range/element references to chat.
blocks.title: Loading, refresh, and context actions

blocks.text: saveFile performs optional formatting, sends an optimistic base version, preserves edits typed during the request, updates metadata, and records errors or conflicts. Related handlers reload theirs, keep mine, refresh AI updates, download ZIPs, search, and jump to code.
blocks.title: Saving and conflict handling

blocks.text: Proposal review and tray actions resolve, reject, keep, or regenerate edits with special handling for deploy and wireframe proposals. The component then derives layout, pending proposal, findings, diagnostics, search, history, and console panel data.
blocks.title: Proposal review and workbench derived state

blocks.text: The returned tree lays out explorer, editor tabs and panes, preview, bottom panels, status, pending tray, confirmations, conflict comparisons, AI update toast, and quick open while preserving mobile behavior.
blocks.title: Rendered editor shell

blocks.text: The exported component loads persisted layout, consumes the optional initial source override once, and mounts WorkbenchBody beneath EditorStoreProvider for the selected workspace.
blocks.title: Provider boundary

gotchas: Each open file keeps a mounted editor so undo and cursor state survive tab switches.
Automatic refresh does not overwrite dirty buffers; it marks them stale.
A truncated buffer is read-only and proposal deletes require confirmation.

purpose: EditorWorkbench mounts the editor store and WorkbenchBody for a workspace.
